title: Setpoint targets
description: The named platform endpoints a Setpoint policy applies to.

version.description: The policy format version. Must be 1.

url.description: The endpoint URL: an Azure DevOps organization or collection URL. Defaults to github.com on GitHub.

auth.description: How Setpoint signs in. Defaults to pat.

scope.description: Globs over <project-or-owner>/<repo> for the repos this target manages. Required on GitHub; defaults to the whole collection on Azure DevOps.

exclude.description: Globs over <project-or-owner>/<repo> that are left out of scope.

tokenEnv.description: The environment variable that holds the token, instead of SETPOINT_<TARGET>_TOKEN.

appId.description: The GitHub App id, for auth: app. The private key comes from SETPOINT_<TARGET>_APP_KEY.

includeForks.description: Whether forks in scope are managed. They are skipped by default.

targets.description: The targets, keyed by name. Selectors and repo override paths start with the target name.
